title: Element file frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter of an element file (D-015, D-056). The Markdown text follows the closing `---`. Only `id`, `type` and `status` are structural; every other key is a property or relation kind key from the metamodel (D-043). Keys the metamodel does not know are kept unchanged and reported as hints (D-012, SR-016). See docs/adr/0004-element-file-format.md. File name: type prefix, dash, last 12 hex characters of the UUID, never changed (D-056). Value kinds are checked against the metamodel, not by this schema, so any value of an unknown key is kept (SR-016); `$defs/value` describes the values LogReq writes.

status.description: Status key from the metamodel. Only ever set by a person (D-030, SR-017).

normal-form.description: Reserved. Never written; the normal-form version is part of every stored version string (D-027).

value.description: Property value (text, number, date as YYYY-MM-DD, choice key, list) or relation targets. Which one is expected comes from the metamodel; a mismatch is a hint, not a parse error (SR-012 AK3).
